tei:div.tei:p: EMBED Photoshop.Image.7 \s rigs kyi ḍāk+ki lnga la phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes ḍāk+ki yab yum gyi tshogs mchod 'di la bcur gnas pa las: dang po phrin las gdags pa ni: ho dgongs shig gsan du gsol: chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i klong nas: 'gro ba 'dul ba'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin yab yum: mkha' 'gro 'bum tshogs yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: ces bya'o: de nas gnyis pa tshogs kyi dri ma sbyong ba ni: tshogs la bsang chu gtor la swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod: hūm̐ rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis: chos rnams sgyu mar rig pa'i phyir: dngos dang dngos 'dzin bag chags kun: yi ge raṃ khaṃ yaṃ gsum gyis: bsreg cing bkrus te gtor bar bya: dag par ma gyur gang yang med: raṃ khaṃ yaṃ swāhā: zhes brjod pas dag par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hrī trāṃ: ye shes rnam lnga'i rang bzhin las: zhal zas dngos po yi ge lnga: yi ge sgra dang bcas pa yis: tshogs kyang 'od du ltem gyis zhu: 'od phung 'bar ba'i byin rlabs kyis: rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ces byin gyis brlabs so: gsum pa yul spyan drang ba ni: las byang gi spyan 'dren la: longs spyod tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ces btags la dbyangs snyan pos spyan drang ngo : bzhi pa mchod cing bstab pa ni: hūm̐ dus gsum bde gshegs yi dam lha: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: mkha' 'gro sde lnga yab yum 'khor dang bcas dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dam tshig sha za lo ka ḍāk+ki'i tshogs: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: de la sogs pa ḍāk+ki'i rigs rgyud ma lus kun: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad kyang : dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab:

tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: lo ka'i snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kyang : dngos grub bar chad bsal ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya: ma hā kā la ma mo raka mo: du tri phu tri ya ma rā tsa: ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā ko ro tsa na khā hi: ma hā ba su ta khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: ma hā bha liṃ ta khā hi: zhes pa lan bdun gyis 'bul lo: lnga pa tshogs bskang ni: hūm̐ bskang ngo bskal bar thugs dam bskang : tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : dus gsum bla ma yi dam yang : zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting 'dzin tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rak+ta dza gad thugs dam bskang : glu gar sgrub pa'i dam tshig thugs dam bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang gyur cig: dpal chen khro rgyal rta mgrin yab yum yang : zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting 'dzin tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rak+ta dza gad thugs dam bskang : glu gar sgrub pa'i dam tshig thugs dam bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ḍāk+ki sde lnga yab yum 'khor bcas kyang : zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting 'dzin cho gas thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rak+ta dza gad thugs dam bskang : glu gar sgrub pa'i dam tshig thugs dam bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ces pas bskang ngo : don drug pa tshogs kyi bshags pa bya ba ni: gong gi bshags pa la: bdag cag ma rig lus ngag yid gsum gyis: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur pa: zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas so sor bshags: zhes btags la bshags pa bya'o: bdun pa ling ga bsgral ba ni: tshogs phud cha tha ma la: dgra bgegs kyi rū pa byas la:

lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas a mu ka nṛ aṃ gu sha dza: zhes pas yul gang yin gyi rnam par shes pa bkug la: badz+ra a be sha hūm̐: zhes zhags pa'i phyag rgyas bcings: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: zhes lcags sgrog gi phyag rgyas bsdams: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho: zhes dril bu'i phyag rgyas gzugs dang rnam shes dbyer med du bsre'o: de nas ngag tu: hrī ma ha ri ni sa: rā tsa hrī ya: badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod pas bdag rta mgrin yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa la: stod gzhung dang mthun pa la: sman phur bu lcags sol mal nas bton pa ltar bsams la: 'di skad do: hūm̐ nga ni rta mgrin yab yum ste: 'khor du mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: kun kyang mi bzad 'jigs pa'i gzugs: dmar nag me yi mtshon cha 'phro: khro bo'i gzugs la gnam sa gang : stod ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: gnam lcags ngar ma'i phur pa 'dril: smad ni ye shes phur bu ste: nam mkha'i mthongs nas 'dril zhing 'debs: drag por gyur pa'i phur pa ste: btab na lha yang brlag par 'gyur: gnod byed dgra bgegs smos ci dgos: gzigs pa tsam gyis rdul du rlog: hrī: nga ni dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal: khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas rnams: phyag gnyis gnam lcags phur bu 'dril: rgya mdung rtse nas 'brug stong ldir: chang bzung mtshams nas glog stong 'khyugs: chu srin kha nas tsha tsha 'phro: rtse mo mtshon cha 'od zer 'gyed: dgra bgegs steng du mā ra ya: a mu ka u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces chu srin rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas blang ngo : de nas brgyad pa bsgral ba dngos la drug las: dang po lha dang dbye ba ni: bh+yo: rna nyan chen mo phra ma mkhan: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: 'go ba'i lha dang bral bar gyis: che ge mo trag rū tra mā ra ya phaṭa: gnyis pa gzugs la dbab pa ni: bh+yo: las mkhan chen mo'i dus la bab: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs:

gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: rnam shes srog la rnam par phob: a mu ka a be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: gsum pa byad du gzhug pa ni: bh+yo: 'ching byed chen mo'i dus la bab: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: zung zhig sdoms shig rnam par chings: a mu ka shri kri a na ya hūm̐ phaṭa: bzhi pa smyor gzhug pa ni: bh+yo: smyo byed chen mo'i dus la bab: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: lus ngag yid gsum myos par gyis: a mu ka dza la sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: lnga pa gtun du brdung ba ni: bh+yoḥ rdung byed chen mo'i dus la bab: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rdungs: a mu ka bhin dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes bya'o: bh+yo: gdug pa sgrol mkhas ḍāk+ki yab yum tshogs: dgra bgegs sha ni zan bas zhim: dgra bgegs khrag ni chang bas zhim: dgra bgegs rus ni mar bas zhim: dug gsum mchod par 'bul ba'i phyir: ma lus 'khor bcas zhal phyes shig: de nas dgu pa zhal du bstab pa ni: bh+yo dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dug gsum mchod pa 'di: dpal chen rta mgrin yab yum zhal du bstab: gsol zhig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: ḍāk+ki sde bzhi yab yum zhal du bstab: gsol zhig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: 'khor gyi ḍāk+ki las mkhan zhal du bstab: gsol zhig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: chos skyong srung ma sde brgyad zhal du bstab: gsol zhig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub zhu: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog tu gsol: ma hā ru tra u tsa ta khā hi: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā ti: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā pāñtsa a mri ta la khā hi: zhes lan bdun gyis dbul lo:

bcu pa tshogs la rol cig lhag ma'i cho ga bya'o: ḍāk+ki yab yum tshogs mchod 'di: ye shes mtsho rgyal khyod la gtad: las can cig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rdzogs so: a+thi+-i: dge'o: mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (5)ḍāk+ki'i tshogs mchod/ - PAGE 200 - - PAGE 201 -- PAGE 196 -
